baotu_spring.name: Baotu Spring
baotu_spring.tip: Come early to see the springs bubbling before tour groups arrive. The nearby spring water tea houses are a classic stop.

daming_lake.name: Daming Lake
daming_lake.price_text: Free to walk the lake; some pavilions and boat rides charge a small fee
daming_lake.hours: Park open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
daming_lake.tip: Walk the full loop at sunset, then stay for the evening lights on the pavilions.
daming_lake.best: Late afternoon into evening; summer for lotus flowers

thousand_buddha.name: Thousand Buddha Mountain
thousand_buddha.tip: Wear good shoes; the climb is steady and takes about an hour up. The city view from the top is the reward.
thousand_buddha.best: Morning for cooler air and clearer views

shandong_university.name: Shandong University (Central Campus)
shandong_university.price_text: Free to walk the campus; some buildings need permission
shandong_university.hours: Campus grounds generally open in daytime; check access rules on the day
shandong_university.tip: A calm green campus near the old town. Ask at the gate about visitor access before you go in.

furong_street.name: Furong Street snack street
furong_street.price_text: Pay per stall; snacks roughly CNY 5–30 each
furong_street.hours: Busiest from late afternoon to around 22:00
furong_street.tip: Try grilled squid, sweet potato noodles and Shandong pancakes. Bring cash or a phone payment app.

qushuiting.name: Qushuiting Street old neighbourhood
qushuiting.tip: A short walk of old lanes, canals and spring-fed pools just east of Baotu Spring. Go slow and look at the doorways.

black_tiger_spring.name: Black Tiger Spring
black_tiger_spring.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
black_tiger_spring.tip: Watch locals fill buckets from the spring spouts. It sits on the moat, so pair it with a walk along the water.

moat_boat.name: Moat and lake boat ride
moat_boat.price_text: ≈ CNY 60–120 depending on route; check on the day
moat_boat.tip: A boat is the easiest way to see the springs and old city from the water. Confirm the route and price at the dock.

shandong_museum.name: Shandong Museum
shandong_museum.price_text: Free with ID; some special exhibitions charge
shandong_museum.tip: Bring your passport for the free ticket. The ancient bronzes and Han dynasty finds are the highlight.

olympic_centre.name: Jinan Olympic Sports Centre
olympic_centre.price_text: Free to walk outside; events ticketed
olympic_centre.hours: Grounds open daily; stadium access only for events
olympic_centre.tip: Come at night to see the lit stadium shapes. It is a long way east, so combine it with the museum.

hero_mountain.name: Hero Mountain viewpoint
hero_mountain.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
hero_mountain.tip: A short climb for a wide view over the city. Good at sunset if the air is clear.

quancheng_square.name: Quancheng Square
quancheng_square.tip: The city's central square and a handy meeting point. Fountains and evening lights draw a crowd.

wulongtan.name: Wulongtan Park (Five Dragon Pool)
wulongtan.tip: Quiet pools and old walls a short walk from Baotu Spring. A good rest stop between sights.

jinan_food_market.name: Local wet market breakfast
jinan_food_market.tip: Go early for fresh baozi, soy milk and Shandong flatbreads. Prices are low and portions are big.

baotu_tea.name: Spring-water tea house stop
baotu_tea.price_text: ≈ CNY 40–100 per pot; check on the day
baotu_tea.tip: Tea brewed with local spring water is a Jinan tradition. Sit outside if the weather is good.

train_station_walk.name: Old city walk from the station
train_station_walk.tip: Walk east from the station toward the springs to get your bearings. It takes about 40 minutes at an easy pace.

shandong_opera.name: Shandong opera or folk show
shandong_opera.tip: Ask your hotel or a ticket desk what is on. Book ahead for weekend shows.

qianfo_street.name: Qianfo Mountain street food lane
qianfo_street.tip: Eat after the mountain climb. Look for grilled skewers and local noodles.

city_wall_park.name: Jiefang Pavilion and old city wall walk
city_wall_park.tip: A short walk linking the lake area and the shopping streets. Good for an evening stroll.

spring_culture_museum.name: Jinan Spring Culture exhibition
spring_culture_museum.price_text: Free or small fee; check on the day
spring_culture_museum.tip: Explains why Jinan is called the City of Springs. A good rainy-day stop near Baotu Spring.

high_tech_park.name: High-tech Zone riverside park
high_tech_park.tip: A modern green strip near the museum and Olympic Centre. Handy for a quiet walk between sights.
